title: alchemilla vulgaris proles undulata
intro: Alchemilla vulgaris proles undulata, commonly known as Lady's Mantle or Undulate Lady's Mantle, is a perennial herb belonging to the Rosaceae family. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, including its ability to promote wound healing, reduce inflammation, and alleviate menstrual cramps due to its health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Alchemilla vulgaris proles undulata include acting as an anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and astringent, making it useful in the treatment of various conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
